records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the location for what i was advised of was an accident major. once i arrived at the location ems was already on scene along with cover officers. it was told to me by officers who had arrived on scene that ped1 may have been clipped by a vehicle (u1) and that u1 fled the location. ems advised police that ped1 was fine and he did not sustain any life threatening injuries, nor could ems even locate any injuries on ped1. as a precaution ems took vitals of ped1, which indicated that he was fine. i then asked w1 who was waiting at the nearby business if he had seen or heard anything. w1 stated that he did hear what sounded like someone getting struck. w1 stated [roadway] off, nb but w1 could not tell me the make or model . there were no security cameras that captured the event, nor were there any other witnesses. ped1 was not very helpful and could only tell police it was a white car. additionally, ped1 could not give any descriptors such as a make or model or license plate. again ems relayed to me that ped1 had no injuries and was only going to be transported because his family who made the location were demanding for ped1 to be transported as a precaution. it was also told to me that ped1 was walking wb down commerce, when he came to the intersection and as he was crossing the vehicle clipped him on the left side. dmea.

records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the listed location for an accident major. it was reported that there was two motor vehicles involved and a person laying on the roadside. i arrived on scene and observed unit 1 in the roadway with it hazard lights on, unit 2 (pedestrian) laying severely injured in the shoulder, and unit 3 directly behind units 1 and 2. i appeared to me that unit 3 had collided with unit 1. i was still unsure how unit 2 was involved or injured in the collision. i the observed unit 3 driver appear on scene from the treeline claiming that he was the passenger of unit 3. i then checked unit 3 driver for intoxication and determined that he was under the influence of intoxicants. it also evident that unit 3 driver was in fact the driver of unit 3. there was a single front airbag deployment on the driver side and both side curtain airbags had deployed due to the nature of the [roadway] from the driver side to the passenger side seat and on the door frame of the passenger side door. during further investigation there was a flat tire to the back right tire of unit 1. there was no frame damages or objects that had punctured this tire. there was also a layer of dust and glass shards coating all interior seats of unit 1 appearing that there was no occupants inside. i observed that unit 2 had facial trauma [roadway] rash on his person. unit 2 was breathing and gasping for air. unit [medical facility]. unit 3 was evaluated for [medical facility] for medical evaluation. unit 3 driver was placed under arrest for driving while intoxicated. sapd traffic investigations arrived on scene and investigated the collision. both units 1 and 3 were towed to growdon storage facility. a driving while intoxicated report was filed under the same [case id] for unit 3 driver. no further actions taken. coban and bwc are available. toxicology testing indicates the driver of unit 3 had a blood ethanol level of . 101 g/dl when a sample was seized from him at 0308 hours. toxicology testing by the medical examiner's office indicates unit 2 had a blood ethanol level of . 197 g/dl and had . 14 mg/l of benzoylecgonine, a cocaine metabolite, [medical facility]. jd 2401
